import os
import tempfile

original_directory = os.getcwd()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    try:
        os.chdir(directory)
        first = {"sha": "a", "authored_at": "2025-01-01T23:00:00Z", "committed_at": "2025-01-03T00:00:00Z", "parent_shas": ["b", "c"]}
        second = {"sha": "b", "authored_at": "2025-01-02T00:00:00Z", "committed_at": "2025-01-02T00:00:00Z", "parent_shas": []}
        data = {"head": "a", "commits": [first, second, dict(first)]}
        expected = {
            "head": "a", "unique_commits": 2,
            "committer_days": [
                {"day": "2025-01-02", "commits": 1, "merges": 0},
                {"day": "2025-01-03", "commits": 1, "merges": 1},
            ],
            "different_author_and_committer_times": 1,
            "evidence": "captured_git_commit_metadata",
        }
        assert task_func(data) == expected
        with open("report.json", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            assert json.load(handle) == expected
        os.mkdir("inputs")
        with open("inputs/commits.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            json.dump({"head": "empty", "commits": []}, handle)
        empty = task_func()
        assert empty == {"head": "empty", "unique_commits": 0, "committer_days": [], "different_author_and_committer_times": 0, "evidence": "captured_git_commit_metadata"}
        with open("report.json", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            assert json.load(handle) == empty
    finally:
        os.chdir(original_directory)

sample = {
    "heads": {"main": "a", "proposed": "b", "unobserved": "c"},
    "total_reported_runs": 100,
    "workflow_runs": [
        {"id": 99, "head_sha": "a", "updated_at": "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z", "status": "completed", "conclusion": "failure"},
        {"id": 9, "head_sha": "a", "updated_at": "2025-01-02T00:00:00Z", "status": "completed", "conclusion": "failure"},
        {"id": 10, "head_sha": "a", "updated_at": "2025-01-02T01:00:00+01:00", "status": "completed", "conclusion": "success"},
        {"id": 11, "head_sha": "b", "updated_at": "2025-01-02T00:00:00Z", "status": "in_progress", "conclusion": "success"}
    ]
}
report = task_func(sample)
assert report["heads"]["main"] == {"head": "a", "latest_observed_run_id": 10, "reported_ci": "passed"}
assert report["heads"]["proposed"]["reported_ci"] == "unknown"
assert report["heads"]["unobserved"] == {"head": "c", "latest_observed_run_id": None, "reported_ci": "unknown"}
assert report["observed_runs"] == 4
assert report["total_reported_runs"] == 100
with open("report.json", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    assert json.load(handle) == report
for conclusion in ("failure", "timed_out", "action_required", "cancelled", None):
    sample["workflow_runs"][-1].update(status="completed", conclusion=conclusion)
    assert task_func(sample)["heads"]["proposed"]["reported_ci"] == ("failed" if conclusion in ("failure", "timed_out", "action_required") else "unknown")
empty = task_func({"heads": {"main": "a"}, "workflow_runs": [], "total_reported_runs": 20})
assert empty["heads"]["main"]["latest_observed_run_id"] is None
assert empty["heads"]["main"]["reported_ci"] == "unknown"
assert empty["observed_runs"] == 0
assert empty["coverage"] == "observed_runs_only"
assert empty["direct_service_health"] == "unknown"
with open("report.json", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    assert json.load(handle) == empty
